mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market and robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE is below 4.0 (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 290) and very low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0) signals an economic policy response to a crisis, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors flee risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 290 AND FEDFUNDS < 1.0 (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher discount rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 during a monetary tightening cycle (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings growth are supported.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1700.0 (thousands of units), it signals strong housing market activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1700.0 (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1700.0) and high residential investment (RSAFS > 670000.0) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1700.0 AND RSAFS > 670000.0 (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 3.0% (annualized), it signals an overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is expected to tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% during a late-cycle expansion (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
